response.raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"The failure was caused by incomplete handling of an embedded Excel workbook inside a PPTX. The update changed the target exchange-rate cell, but the resulting embedded workbook lost readable numeric outputs for dependent and even untouched cells, producing NaN values during verification. Across samples, the recurring issue is insufficient guidance for preserving workbook integrity, recalculation state, cached formula values, and embedded-object packaging when editing and re-embedding .xlsx content within a .pptx container.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"xlsx/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.93","diagnosis":"The XLSX guidance does not sufficiently cover safe modification of existing embedded workbooks where formulas, cached formula results, cell data types, and untouched numeric cells must remain readable by downstream extractors. The observed NaN outputs indicate formulas were preserved textually but recalculated/cached values or workbook state were not properly maintained after saving.","repair_instruction":"Add explicit guidance for editing embedded .xlsx files inside Office containers: preserve workbook structure, formulas, sheet layouts, number formats, and untouched cells; avoid recreating sheets/ranges unnecessarily; ensure dependent formulas have valid cached results after edits; and document recalculation workflows using tools such as LibreOffice headless recalculation or workbook calc properties/fullCalcOnLoad. Include warnings that some readers rely on cached values instead of recalculating formulas automatically, and add post-save validation steps that compare updated and untouched cells against the original workbook."},{"path":"pptx/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.86","diagnosis":"The PPTX guidance explains unpacking and XML access but lacks a concrete workflow for safely modifying embedded Excel objects under ppt/embeddings while preserving relationships, workbook integrity, and recalculation behavior. The task required extracting, editing, validating, and re-embedding an XLSX without corrupting unrelated table data.","repair_instruction":"Add a dedicated section for embedded Excel object workflows in PPTX files. Cover locating embedded workbooks under ppt/embeddings, preserving relationship files and object names, safely replacing updated workbook binaries, and validating the embedded workbook after repackaging. Include an end-to-end checklist: extract workbook, modify target cells, recalculate/preserve cached values, reopen the workbook to verify dependent and untouched cells, then re-embed and confirm the PPTX package structure remains intact."}],"unselected_skills":[]}
